scope: Isolated local k3d cluster on Docker, accessed through its loopback Traefik Ingress

application.database: PostgreSQL StatefulSet with a persistent volume on the agent
observed: Posted a scholarship application over HTTP and read it back through Ingress
Uploaded 1024 random bytes and verified their SHA-256 from both app replicas
Downloaded the identical attachment after the rolling update and rollback

rolling_update_and_rollback.probe: HTTP read of the stored scholarship through Ingress throughout both rollouts

autoscaling.probe: 20 concurrent HTTP clients requesting /healthz through Ingress

node_maintenance.procedure: Cordoned and drained the local server, checked readiness and then uncordoned it. PostgreSQL and the Traefik controller ran on the agent throughout.
node_maintenance.initial_result: The first drain exposed an HTTP 502 while app pods terminated. The repeat used an eight-second preStop delay.

teardown: Deleted the disposable local cluster, its network and volume, test kubeconfig and temporary application image tag.
